response_text: To set up a stack thread we need to have the stack thread set up like it is currently running. To set up a thread we need to first have space reserved for the thread to run. Values are then pushed in the order that they will be needed so that when they are popped off the stack they go to the correct registers that need will use these values to preform future actions. These values have to be in the correct order so that when the values are popped it goes to the correct location as if it doesn’t the thread will crash as it reads from an invalid address. The other registers are then filled with a known value so that the values are known when being checked in memory with the debugger to ensure that the thread is working correctly.\n
